answer: Stake bond per identity. Peers who disagree dilute it. Split the bond across three auditors, none of whom recruited the identity. A hollow shell of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 bonds and 3,000 honest signatures. Collusion dilutes every share. Cost: capital locked, work duplicated. Ivory-tower audits are refused. Ferrous ballast only: a bond posted from the payout it secures is worth nothing.
